notes: Published LNG terminal and TSO entry charges, transcribed by a person from the regulator's or operator's own publication, one figure per row, each with its URL, publication date, the date it was read and a terms note.
Nothing here is fetched at run time. A firm's own terms and a reviewed register row (lng_terminal_tariff) take precedence over these figures; these price a cargo only where the firm holds neither.

status is the publisher's own status (FINAL: approved or stated final; INDICATIVE: provisional, a cap, a last-sale price, or a figure not yet checked against the authoritative text). It is not the firm's four-eyes review.
A terminal with no published price for a new booking (exempt, fully contracted or negotiated) says so in not_published and is never given a figure.
